name: make-prompt-better
description: Research-grounded prompt and agent-context optimization with four task-proportional modes, requirement preservation, and deterministic linting.

scripts.verify:fast: python3 scripts/validate_repo.py && python3 scripts/check-release.py && npm run lint && bash -n install.sh
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s research/benchmark/v4 -p 'test_*.py' -v && node scripts/lint-prompt.mjs --self-test && python3 research/benchmark/v4/blind_stats_engine.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.lint: python3 lint_context.py --self-test && python3 lint_context.py CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md && node scripts/lint-prompt.mjs CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md

author: Paulo Ferraz
